probes.label: distilled, aligned and morphed models and published PCM
changed morph envelope on rerun
probes.assertions:
val expectedA = client.distill(film.crop(1.6, 3.6), LorisReference.Estimated(150.0, 450.0))
val expectedB = client.distill(film.crop(11.5, 13.5), LorisReference.Estimated(60.0, 200.0))
val expectedAligned = client.dilate(expectedB.model, [0.0, expectedB.model.loudestTimeSeconds(), end], [0.0, expectedA.model.loudestTimeSeconds(), end], durationSeconds = end)
val expectedRaw = client.morph(expectedA.model.dropUnlabeled(), expectedAligned.model.dropUnlabeled(), LorisEnvelope.ramp(morphStart, morphEnd))
val expectedGain = if (expectedRaw.peak > 0.95f) 0.95 / expectedRaw.peak else 1.0
val expected = if (expectedGain == 1.0) expectedRaw else client.synthesize(expectedRaw.model.transformed(gain = expectedGain))
check(a == expectedA.model && b == expectedB.model && aligned == expectedAligned.model)
check(morphed.model == expected.model && morphed.samples.contentEquals(expected.samples))
